# ShopGlowz

ShopGlowz is an independent project for people who want to discover useful gadgets, compare curated selections, and understand what to verify before buying from different merchants.

## Public guides

- Kitchen gadgets: /guides/kitchen-gadgets
- Summer cooling: /guides/summer-cooling
- Gift ideas: /guides/gifts
- Camping and outdoors: /guides/camping
- Office and tech gadgets: /guides/tech-gadgets

## Repères pratiques

- Ajustement de prix Temu : /blog/ajustement-prix-temu
- Colis Temu marqué livré mais introuvable : /blog/colis-temu-marque-livre-introuvable
- Comment comparer deux produits AliExpress qui se ressemblent : /blog/comparer-deux-produits-aliexpress-qui-se-ressemblent
- Comment comparer deux produits Amazon qui se ressemblent : /blog/comparer-deux-produits-amazon-qui-se-ressemblent
- Comment comparer deux produits Temu qui se ressemblent : /blog/comparer-deux-produits-temu-qui-se-ressemblent
- Commande Temu et seuil de 150 € : /blog/droits-douane-temu-colis-150-euros
- Entrepôt local sur Temu : /blog/entrepot-local-temu-ce-que-ca-change
- Montant minimum Temu : /blog/montant-minimum-commande-temu-verifier-panier
- Pourquoi une commande Temu arrive en plusieurs colis : /blog/pourquoi-commande-temu-divisee-plusieurs-colis
- Prix barrés et stock limité sur Temu : /blog/prix-barres-stock-limite-temu-que-verifier

- Temu : d’où vient l’entreprise et comment les recommandations fonctionnent : /blog/temu-entreprise-origine-recommandations
- Qui vend sur Amazon ? : /blog/qui-vend-sur-amazon-marketplace-vendeur-marque
- Qui vend sur Temu ? : /blog/qui-vend-sur-temu-marketplace-vendeur-marque

Only these published guides are intended as current public recommendation pages. Product details, prices, variants and availability can change; readers should verify them on the merchant page before ordering.

## Editorial approach

- ShopGlowz is not currently an official partner of the merchants it may cite.
- Published selections are editorial curation, not hands-on product testing unless a page explicitly documents that evidence.
- If ShopGlowz later uses affiliate links, the relationship and possible commission will be disclosed clearly near recommendations.
- ShopGlowz does not claim verified sellers, live availability, guaranteed prices or paid placements without documented proof.
